caveat: critic OOF only: fixed encoder itself was trained on entire TRAIN fold; no independent content generalization claim
fold_group: physical source; sourceclass stratified; all instructions/variants together
fold_order: sha256(salt + NUL + source_id) per sourceclass, sorted, roundrobin4
forward_rule: one model._forward(train.low) with retained hidden and p/q plus one model._forward(train.full) per selected NC model; both actual202dim
intercept: unpenalized; weighted centered normalized features for classifier, ordinary centered features for MSE
normalization: fold TRAIN unweighted feature mean/std floor.05
source_weighting: equal physical sources then equal model seeds
validation_rule: saved validationreceipt decomposition only; no validation data construction
